papers.title: Impact of ACT DR6 and DESI DR2 for Early Dark Energy and the Hubble tension
papers.relevance: Provides ACT DR6 + DESI DR2 constraints on EDE; discusses H0 tension reduction to ~2 sigma; includes profile-likelihood analysis.
papers.key_numbers: f_EDE < 0.109 (95% CL) for P-ACT-LBS; Delta chi^2 = -7.0 (CMB+DESI) and -35.4 (with SH0ES)

papers.title: Early time solution as an alternative to the late time evolving dark energy with DESI DR2 BAO
papers.relevance: Primary target paper. Compares LCDM, EDE, and w0wa using CMB+DESI (+SNe). Table II/III/IV contain best-fit parameters and Delta chi^2. Figure 6 shows BAO/SNe residuals.
papers.key_numbers: Delta chi^2(EDE vs LCDM) = -7.4 for CMB+BAO; Delta chi^2(w0wa vs LCDM) = -13 for CMB+BAO; H0(EDE)=70.9 +/- 1.0; f_EDE=0.093 +/- 0.031

papers.title: Observational Constraints on Early Dark Energy
papers.relevance: Review of EDE constraints from Planck, LSS, BOSS, weak lensing. Shows Bayesian preference for LCDM over EDE when LSS is included.
papers.key_numbers: f_EDE < 0.072 (95% CL) with BOSS EFT; f_EDE < 0.053 with photometric LSS

papers.title: Constraining Early Dark Energy with Large-Scale Structure
papers.relevance: First EDE analysis with BOSS full-shape EFT likelihood; demonstrates stronger EDE constraints than standard BOSS likelihood.

papers.title: Early Dark Energy Can Resolve The Hubble Tension
papers.relevance: Original EDE proposal using axion-like potential; showed that EDE can raise H0 while fitting CMB, BAO, and SN data.
